result.fundName: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 4.36% (19.00% vs 14.64%).
Beat the benchmark in 100.0% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Flexi Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.48 vs benchmark 0.90, Sortino 2.04.
Defensive profile: beta 0.59 with 28% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 9.62% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.27).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -12.36% vs benchmark -20.06%.
Rolling return range spans 17.24% to 21.49% (4.25 pp spread) — consistency score 100.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
